purpose: We research kidney function among patients with heart failure to improve treatment.
question: How many patients with heart failure have an eGFR value and what is their mean latest eGFR, by hospital?
definitions: Heart failure = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with I50.
Use the latest eGFR per patient; patients without an eGFR are left out.
Report per hospital: patients with heart failure who have an eGFR value and mean eGFR with one decimal.
